# Terms of Service for CloudSync

**Last Updated: October 26, 2023**

## 1. Definitions
In these Terms of Service, "CloudSync" refers to the software-as-a-service platform and associated services provided by CloudSync Inc. to enable users to synchronize, store, and manage data across various devices and cloud environments. The term "Service" encompasses the software application, APIs, documentation, and any related support or maintenance features delivered through the CloudSync platform. When we refer to "You" or the "User," we mean any individual or legal entity that accesses or uses the Service in accordance with these terms.

"Data" refers to all content, files, documents, and information uploaded, stored, or transmitted by the User through the Service. This includes, but is not limited to, personal information, business records, and proprietary files. "Content" specifically denotes the Data owned or controlled by the User, while "Service Content" refers to the underlying code, design, and functionality of the CloudSync platform itself, which remains the exclusive property of CloudSync Inc.

"Subscription" means the specific plan or package selected by the User to access the Service, which may include varying levels of storage capacity, feature sets, and support tiers. "Authorized User" refers to any individual explicitly permitted by the primary account holder to access the Service under the terms of the specific Subscription. These definitions are fundamental to understanding the rights and obligations outlined in the subsequent sections of this agreement.

By creating an account with CloudSync, you represent and warrant that you are at least eighteen (18) years of age or have the legal capacity to enter into a binding agreement. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials, including your username and password, and for all activities that occur under your account. You agree to notify CloudSync immediately of any unauthorized use of your account or any other breach of security.

You are permitted to create a single account per individual or legal entity unless a specific enterprise agreement states otherwise. You must provide accurate, current, and complete information during the registration process and keep this information up to date. CloudSync reserves the right to suspend or terminate any account that provides false information or fails to comply with the verification processes required to ensure the integrity of the platform.

If your account is designated as a team or organization account, the primary account holder is responsible for managing the permissions and activities of all Authorized Users. The primary holder must ensure that all Authorized Users adhere to these Terms of Service and the Acceptable Use Policy. CloudSync is not liable for any actions taken by Authorized Users that violate these terms, provided that the primary account holder has taken reasonable steps to manage access and compliance.

## 3. Payment Terms
All fees associated with your Subscription are billed in advance on a recurring basis, either monthly or annually, depending on the plan you select. Prices are listed in United States Dollars (USD) unless otherwise specified at the point of purchase, and are subject to change with reasonable notice. By accepting these Terms, you authorize CloudSync to charge the payment method you provide for all applicable fees, taxes, and any usage overages that may occur.

CloudSync reserves the right to adjust pricing for new Subscriptions or existing Subscriptions upon providing at least thirty (30) days' written notice. If you do not agree to the price increase, you may cancel your Subscription before the effective date of the change, and your account will be terminated at the end of the current billing cycle. Any refunds for price adjustments are generally not provided for partial billing cycles unless required by local law.

If a payment fails for any reason, CloudSync will attempt to retry the charge in accordance with the billing cycle. If the payment remains unsuccessful after multiple attempts, your access to the Service may be temporarily suspended until the outstanding balance is paid in full. Persistent non-payment may result in the termination of your account and the deletion of your Data, as outlined in the Termination section of these Terms.

Any attempt to interfere with the proper working of the Service, including but not limited to denial-of-service attacks, is strictly forbidden.

You may not use the Service to store, transmit, or distribute any content that is illegal, defamatory, obscene, pornographic, or that promotes violence or hate speech. Furthermore, you are prohibited from engaging in any activity that violates the intellectual property rights of others, including the unauthorized distribution of copyrighted material. CloudSync reserves the right to monitor and review content for compliance with these policies and to remove any content that violates these standards without prior notice.

You agree not to reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble, or attempt to derive the source code of the Service, except to the extent expressly permitted by applicable law.
